description: GuvFX-TIM operational signing trust store. PUBLIC verification keys only; never any private key, seed, password or token. Pins the operational producer public key provisioned + custody-verified under GO #2a (GFX-TIM-GO2A-ED25519-KEY-PROVISION-039 / GFX-TIM-GO2A-PUBLIC-KEY-PIN-040). Operational signature verification fails closed (unknown_signing_key) for any signing_key_id not pinned here. Rotation = add the new signing_key_id and keep the previous active during overlap; revocation = set status to 'revoked' (keep, do not delete).
